'''Jurgan Kalta's assault rifle''' was the favorite weapon of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jurgan Kalta]], who was active before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. The weapon was capable of dealing both [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion damage]] and the standard damage dealt by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Sometime after Kalta's [[Death/Legends|death]], this accurate, high-powered [[Assault blaster rifle|assault rifle]] came into the possession of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] businessman [[Crattis Yurkal]].

==Description==
[[Jurgan Kalta]]'s [[Assault blaster rifle|assault rifle]] was much more accurate than the standard [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. It had increased effectiveness against [[Droid/Legends|droids]] since it dealt [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion damage]], as well as the standard energy damage caused by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Due to its size, firing the weapon effectively required two [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. The weapon had a [[Color/Legends|silver-blue]] finish and had an effective range of twenty-eight [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="kotor" /> which was comparable to other blaster rifle designs in use during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="kotorrange">The ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' game manual states the range of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] as twenty-eight [[Meter/Legends|meters]].</ref> The rifle was able to receive upgrades to its [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]], [[firing chamber]], [[Scope/Legends|scope]], and [[Hair trigger/Legends|trigger]].<ref name="kotor" />

==History==
The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] Jurgan Kalta,<ref name="kotor" /> who was active before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|196|Kalta, Jurgan}}</ref> and known for his adaptability, owned this assault rifle prior to his [[Death/Legends|death]] from a [[gaxxan brain-slug]],<ref name="kotor" /> which occurred by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="kotorcg" /> Even though Kalta owned a powerful [[Jurgan Kalta's carbine|carbine]], the assault rifle was his favorite firearm, as the weapon's adaptability complemented his own.<ref name="kotor" /> By 3956 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> the weapon was owned by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] businessman [[Crattis Yurkal]]. He had the weapon for sale at his store, [[Aratech Mercantile]], in the [[Jedi Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], for 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="kotor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jurgan Kalta's assault rifle appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game, it was a unique, upgradeable weapon that the player could purchase from Crattis Yurkal at his shop inside the Jedi Enclave on the planet Dantooine. Compared to the standard blaster rifle, the weapon's statistics had a large increase to the attack bonus, as well as a large ion damage bonus against droids. While the game does not state when the assault rifle was constructed,<ref name="kotor" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' established that Jurgan Kalta was active before the Great [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] War,<ref name="TCSWE" /> which occurred in [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
